sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import tarfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
bundles=sorted(root.glob('.telegram-leads-*.tgz'))
for p in bundles:
 if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():continue
 print('BUNDLE_NAME',p.name)
 print('BUNDLE_BYTES',p.stat().st_size)
 try:
  with tarfile.open(p,'r:gz') as tar:
   names=tar.getnames()
   print('BUNDLE_MEMBERS',len(names))
   print('BUNDLE_HAS_SAFE_RUNTIME','scripts/safe_runtime.py' in names)
   print('BUNDLE_HAS_INSTALLER','scripts/deploy_project_only.py' in names)
   f=tar.extractfile('scripts/safe_runtime.py')
   if f:
    data=f.read()
    active=(root/'scripts/safe_runtime.py').read_bytes()
    print('BUNDLE_SAFE_RUNTIME_MATCHES_INSTALLED',hashlib.sha256(data).digest()==hashlib.sha256(active).digest())
 except (tarfile.TarError,KeyError,OSError):
  print('BUNDLE_VALID',False)
print('BUNDLE_INSPECTION_READONLY_COMPLETE')
PY
